project_context.tagline: IT Business Analysis solutions & AI product building

headings.font_family: var(--font-sans) — San Francisco via -apple-system, with native OS fallbacks
headings.tracking: -0.028em at h1, easing to -0.014em at h4; SF needs tighter tracking as size grows
headings.rule: System font only. No webfonts — do not reintroduce a Google Fonts link.

body.font_family: var(--font-sans) — San Francisco via -apple-system, with native OS fallbacks

mono.font_family: var(--font-mono) — SF Mono via ui-monospace, with native OS fallbacks

marketing_pages.grid: Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12)

admin_dashboard.alignment: Strict grid hierarchy, all pixels utilized

marketing_ui.rule: Custom HTML + Tailwind. Avoid Shadcn containers. Use raw divs.
marketing_ui.surface: Solid backgrounds, sharp borders. 1px solid strokes (border-slate-200) instead of soft drop shadows.

dashboard_ui.surface: Cardless or flat cards with max 4px border-radius, dense data grids, monochrome + accent colors.

buttons.primary: bg-[#093D45] text-white hover:bg-[#13626C] rounded-none px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#020617] hover:bg-[#D97706] rounded-none px-6 py-3 transition-colors font-medium
buttons.ghost: border border-[#E2E8F0] text-[#020617] hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-none px-6 py-3

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Duotone or Regular weight, crisp and enterprise-grade

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text over teal background is white. Ensure amber buttons have dark text (APCA verified).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: ALL interactive elements MUST include a kebab-case data-testid (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='login-submit')

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement marketing pages with pure HTML/Tailwind for max layout control. Use 'Bento Grid' patterns with wide gaps.
For the PLP/PDP (services), keep it highly professional, leveraging the provided consultation meeting images.
The CMS dashboard should use Shadcn with a strictly flat, light-themed 'Swiss' brutalist approach. High contrast text.
Integrate a floating AI chat widget (Claude Sonnet 4.5 proxy) on the bottom right of marketing pages.
Implement SEO meta tags, Robots.txt, Sitemap generation logic, and JSON-LD schema markup for the services.
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for all iconography.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
